recommended_channels.rationale: CISOs and security leaders actively research solutions on LinkedIn. Varonis dominates organic search on LinkedIn; we can differentiate via account-based marketing (ABM) targeting specific prospect accounts with Salesforce focus. Founder's strong network enables authentic thought leadership positioning.
risk_factors: Audience fatigue if too aggressive with ad frequency

recommended_channels.rationale: CISOs rely on Gartner, Forrester, and IDC evaluations for vendor shortlisting. Varonis' post-acquisition deprioritization of mid-market creates opportunity to secure favorable analyst positioning. Requires 8-12 week lead time but high credibility multiplier.
risk_factors: Analyst selection process is opaque and competitive
Analyst reports take 2-3 months to publish
success_metrics: Analyst mention frequency in sales discussions

recommended_channels.rationale: Security buyers conduct 6-10 hours of research before engaging sales. Content on 'Salesforce insider threat case studies', 'DLP ROI calculators', and 'compliance frameworks' positions us as category experts. Builds organic authority over 4-6 months while supporting other channels.
risk_factors: Team must maintain publication cadence (bi-weekly minimum)

recommended_channels.rationale: Partner with Salesforce consulting practices, CISO communities (like We Community, CISO Collective), and compliance platforms (Domo, Tableau partnerships). Co-marketing and referral relationships provide credibility and distribution. Leverage founder's existing network.
risk_factors: Partner incentive alignment takes 4-6 weeks to negotiate

recommended_channels.rationale: RSA Conference, Black Hat, and InfoSecWorld reach target CISO audience in high-intent environment. Sponsorship + speaking slot creates visibility and lead generation opportunity. Attend RSA (Feb 2024) as primary opportunity.
risk_factors: Requires 3-month advance planning and CFP submission

channels_to_avoid.reason: CISO buyers do not respond to broad 'DLP solution' keywords. Google Ads favors high-volume, low-complexity products. Would require large budget ($15k+/month) to achieve meaningful CISO audience reach. Better to allocate to LinkedIn.
Product Hunt audience is primarily early-stage startups and engineers, not CISOs making enterprise security procurement decisions. Not aligned with buyer profile.
Target audience (CISOs 35-55) does not spend meaningful time on TikTok. Distribution channel mismatch.

market_gaps: Analyst relations (Varonis deprioritizing post-acquisition, Imperva underfunding relative to Gartner influence)
Salesforce-specific positioning (no competitor owns 'Salesforce insider threat prevention' narrative)
CISO community partnerships (engagement with CISO Collective, We Community remains fragmented)
competitive_analysis.trends_analysis: Post-Varonis acquisition by STG, there is a 6-12 month window where the mid-market CISO buyer is underserved. Competitors are consolidating rather than innovating. This creates an opportunity to position DataShield as the nimble, CISO-focused alternative while analyst relations maturation is underway.

team_composition: 1.0 FTE Content Marketing + Analyst Relations Manager
required_tools: LinkedIn Campaign Manager and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot) for lead tracking

next_steps: Day 1: Set up LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Sales Navigator; begin prospect list building for ABM targeting
Day 2-3: Draft analyst relations outreach strategy; identify 3 primary analysts for briefing requests
Day 4-5: Create content calendar for next 12 weeks (insider threat case studies, ROI calculators, compliance guides)
Day 6-7: Identify and reach out to 5 potential partners (Salesforce consulting practices, CISO communities)
Week 2: Launch first paid LinkedIn campaign (targeting VP Security/CISO + Salesforce focus); begin analyst briefing outreach
Week 3-4: Publish first 2 content pieces; schedule partnership calls
Week 5-6: Evaluate LinkedIn CAC and conversion metrics; pivot if needed; lock in conference attendance/sponsorship
Week 8+: Review analyst interest, refine messaging based on early feedback, plan next quarter expansion
